stem.text: A student carried out a Benedict’s test on several different known concentrations of $\alpha$-glucose.
Which graph represents the results correctly?

A.alt: Graph: vertical axis 'time to first colour change', horizontal axis 'concentration of α-glucose'; one curve drawn.

B.alt: Graph: vertical axis 'concentration of α-glucose', horizontal axis 'time to first colour change'; one curve drawn.

C.alt: Graph: vertical axis 'concentration of α-glucose', horizontal axis 'time to first colour change'; one curve drawn.

D.alt: Graph: vertical axis 'time to first colour change', horizontal axis 'concentration of α-glucose'; one curve drawn.
